subject: ss-haematology
title: Thrombotic microangiopathies TTP HUS and complement disease
refs: Harrison Principles of Internal Medicine 22e Ch 105 Hemolytic Anemias TTP HUS sections

steps.tx: **Thrombotic microangiopathy** (TMA, small vessel clotting with organ injury) shows a fixed triad. **Microangiopathic haemolytic anaemia** (MAHA, red cells sheared by vessel clots) gives schistocytes (helmet fragmented cells) on smear with high **LDH** (cell damage enzyme). **Thrombocytopenia** (low platelets) follows platelet consumption in clots. **Organ injury** (kidney, brain, heart) completes the picture. **Normal coagulation tests** separate TMA from **DIC** (consumption coagulopathy).
steps.say: TMA is MAHA plus low platelets plus organ injury. Schistocytes shear through narrowed vessels with high LDH. Normal coagulation tests separate TMA from DIC clearly.

steps.tx: **Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura** (TTP, ADAMTS13 deficiency disease) is the TMA emergency. **ADAMTS13** (enzyme cutting large von Willebrand multimers) falls below **10** percent in TTP, letting giant clots form. **Pentad** (fever, confusion, renal failure, haemolysis, thrombocytopenia) is fully present in a minority today. **Normal kidney function** favours TTP over **HUS** (kidney dominant disease). **Platelet transfusion** is avoided except for life threatening bleeding.
steps.say: TTP stems from ADAMTS13 falling below ten percent. The full pentad appears in only a minority today. Normal kidney function is more typical of TTP.

steps.tx: **Plasma exchange** (therapeutic plasma replacement, PEX) is the lifesaving therapy of TTP and starts before test results return. **Caplacizumab** (anti von Willebrand nanobody) blocks **GPIb** (platelet receptor) clumping during exchange. **Corticosteroids** (prednisolone) suppress autoantibodies against ADAMTS13. **Rituximab** (anti B cell antibody) is added for refractory or relapsed immune TTP. **Neurological knots** (confusion, seizures) dominate early presentations in adults.
steps.say: Plasma exchange starts promptly before ADAMTS13 results return. Caplacizumab blocks platelet clumping during exchange therapy. Rituximab helps refractory immune TTP cases widely in practice.

steps.tx: **Shiga toxin HUS** (STEC HUS, toxin kidney failure) follows bloody diarrhoea by **5** to **10** days. **Shiga toxin producing E coli** (STEC, gut bacteria) damages endothelium in kidneys first. **Children** under **5** years carry the highest risk, with **CNS** (central nervous system) involvement in severe cases. **Supportive care** (dialysis, careful fluids) remains the treatment, and **antibiotics** (killing bacteria) and antimotility drugs worsen toxin release. **Plasma exchange** offers no benefit in STEC HUS.
steps.say: STEC HUS follows bloody diarrhoea by five to ten days. Antibiotics worsen toxin release and must be avoided. Supportive dialysis remains the treatment for STEC HUS.

steps.tx: **Atypical HUS** (aHUS, complement driven childhood and adult HUS) is complement dysregulation without STEC. **Complement factor H** (regulator protein) mutations and anti factor H antibodies drive most cases. **Eculizumab** (C5 complement blocker, terminal complement inhibitor) rescues kidney function in most patients. **Meningococcal vaccination** (meningitis vaccine) must precede eculizumab because C5 blockade invites meningococcal sepsis. **Plasma exchange** serves only as a bridge until complement blockade starts.
steps.say: Atypical HUS is a complement dysregulation disease without STEC toxin. Eculizumab rescues kidney function in most treated patients. Meningococcal vaccination must precede complement blockade here in practice. Genetic counselling follows for relatives in families.

steps.tx: Secondary TMA has named triggers that exams love. **Drug induced TMA** (from gemcitabine, antiplatelet and calcineurin blocker drugs) stops with drug withdrawal. **Calcineurin inhibitor TMA** (immune suppressor drug effect) plagues transplant recipients. **Pre eclampsia HELLP** (haemolysis, high liver enzymes, low platelets) resolves with delivery. **Malignant hypertension** (severe high pressure) injures vessels widely. **Cobalamin C defect** (vitamin B twelve pathway disease) mimics TMA in infants with high homocysteine.
steps.say: Drug induced TMA stops promptly with drug withdrawal. HELLP is resolved by delivery of the placenta itself. Malignant hypertension is a cause of wide vessel injury in TMA cases.

steps.tx: The **DIC versus TMA** (consumption versus vessel clot) split decides urgent therapy. **DIC** (disseminated intravascular coagulation) lowers **fibrinogen** (clotting protein) and raises **D dimer** (fibrin breakdown marker) with prolonged PT aPTT. **TMA** keeps fibrinogen normal with normal clotting times and schistocytes dominant. **Sepsis** (infection) drives most DIC, while **ADAMTS13** drives TTP. **Blood products** treat DIC bleeding, while platelet transfusion harms TTP.
steps.say: DIC is marked by low fibrinogen while TMA has normal fibrinogen. DIC prolongs clotting times and TMA leaves them normal. Platelet transfusion harms TTP but treats DIC bleeding.

steps.tx: Prognosis tracks organ damage and speed of therapy. **Acute kidney injury** (kidney failure) needing dialysis in **twenty** to **forty** percent of aHUS persists without complement blockade. **Stroke** (brain clots) and **myocardial infarction** (heart attack) threaten TTP in the first days. Mortality fell from above **90** percent to below **10** percent after plasma exchange reached TTP care. **Relapse** affects **forty** percent of immune TTP within **2** years, tracked by **ADAMTS13** monitoring.
steps.say: Mortality fell below ten percent after plasma exchange reached TTP care. Relapse affects forty percent within two years of remission. ADAMTS13 monitoring tracks relapse risk closely.

steps.tx: Newer evidence reshaped aHUS care. **Ravulizumab** (long acting C5 blocker, every **eight** weeks) matches eculizumab with longer dosing intervals. **Eculizumab discontinuation** (stopping block) is considered after **3** to **6** months of remission, since relapse risk falls with time. **Genetic testing** (complement gene panel) guides relapse counselling and family screening. **Plasma exchange** has no proven role in STEC HUS and wastes resources there.
steps.say: Ravulizumab matches eculizumab with longer dosing intervals. Eculizumab stopping is considered after three to six months. Genetic testing guides relapse counselling and family screening.

steps.tx: Exam stems repeat these discriminators. **ADAMTS13 below 10** percent confirms TTP and never STEC HUS. **Bloody diarrhoea five days prior** points to STEC HUS, not TTP. **Normal fibrinogen** with schistocytes points to TMA over DIC. **Eculizumab** is the answer for complement mediated aHUS, while **plasma exchange** is the answer for TTP.
steps.say: ADAMTS13 below ten percent confirms TTP every time. Bloody diarrhoea five days prior points to STEC HUS. Plasma exchange is the treatment for TTP while eculizumab is for aHUS disease.

steps.tx: High-yield for the exam: TMA triad is **MAHA** with schistocytes, **low platelets**, and **organ injury** with normal clotting tests. **ADAMTS13 below 10** percent confirms TTP, and **plasma exchange** starts immediately. **STEC HUS** follows bloody diarrhoea in **5** to **10** days and **antibiotics** worsen it. **aHUS** needs **eculizumab** after meningococcal vaccination.
steps.say: TMA is MAHA plus low platelets plus organ injury. ADAMTS13 below ten percent confirms TTP clearly. STEC HUS follows bloody diarrhoea by five to ten days only.
